summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Laguna Beach Unified School District to issue up to $83 million in general obligation bonds, repaid by local property taxes, to fund school facility projects.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes up to $83 million in bonds and an expected tax rate of approximately $8.85 per $100,000 of assessed value to fund school facility improvements.
tax.quote: If approved by voters, Measure A would authorize up to $83 million in bonds for school facilities improvements.

schools.text: A Yes vote directs bond funds to improvements in Laguna Beach Unified School District public schools.
schools.quote: By law, all money raised by Measure A could only be used to improve local schools, and could not be taken away by State or used for other purposes

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the new bonds or their associated tax, leaving the proposed facility improvements without Measure A funding.
tax.quote: If approved by voters, Measure A would authorize up to $83 million in bonds for school facilities improvements.

schools.text: A No vote does not authorize Measure A funds for district public school improvements.
